info.title: Dancity API
info.description: Paths below match the server base URL + global prefix `api`. Merchant: `Authorization: Bearer dcy_live_...` and `channel: API`. App: JWT. See Guides for flows.

tags.name: VAS
tags.description: Merchant API (`/api/v1`): catalog GETs (wallet, services, products, plans) and purchase routes; `channel: API` on POST buys; app education & betting where listed

tags.name: Products & services
tags.description: Catalog GETs: all services; products and plans with optional query filters

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Fetch your transactions and requery one by id for current status

tags.name: Webhook
tags.description: Outbound events Dancity POSTs to your configured HTTPS URL

DancityApiKey.description: Merchant API key from the Dancity dashboard.

ChannelHeader.name: channel
ChannelHeader.description: Required on VAS (merchant `/api/v1`) requests. Use `API` for server integrations.

JwtAuth.description: Bearer token from Dancity user authentication.

PartnerWebhookPayload.description: POST body Dancity sends to your configured HTTPS webhook URL (set in the Dancity app / API key settings).

parameters.name: regionCode
parameters.description: Region code from GET /api/v1/esim/regions (e.g. `NG` for Nigeria, `EU-42` for a multi-country region).

parameters.name: regionType
parameters.description: Region classification from the regions list — pass the selected region's `type` value. `country` = single country (default), `multi-country` = regional bundle covering multiple countries.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Package category: `BASE` = new eSIM to install, `TOPUP` = add data to an existing eSIM. Defaults to `BASE`.

get.description: Returns add-on data packages compatible with an existing eSIM. Pass the eSIM's ICCID from a prior purchase, `GET /api/v1/esim/my-esims`, or `GET /api/v1/esim/details/{transactionId}`. Purchase a returned `packageCode` via `POST /api/v1/esim/purchase`.

post.description: Dancity POSTs this payload to your configured HTTPS webhook URL when transaction events occur. You do not call this on the Dancity API — implement an endpoint on your server to receive it. Verify `X-Dancity-Signature` as in Guides → Webhook.
